summary: Have fun sinking the enemy fleet with our sea battle two players.
description: One of the known childhood games around the world, now on your smartphone! Boat Battle in English is a classic strategy game where you will have to find out the position of your opponent's ships, before they find your ships and sink your fleet. Enter the enemy waters and intercept all the ships of the opposing fleet with your intuition and strategy. If you like to play ship battle, you are going to love this game. We have recreated the classic game that you played with paper and pen, adding fun animations and designs that will make you forget the notebook. In addition, you can choose the game background that you like the most. Prepare all your arsenal and shoot ships of different sizes. Show that you are the best commander of the crew! FEATURES - Available in several languages - Attractive design inspired by paper games - Upgrade your ships and choose your favorite avatar - For all ages - Completely free game - Offline games for free It’s time to plan the tactics you will use to sink the ships in this naval battle. Hurry up and play with your captain's intuition to be the first to find each of the ships in the enemy fleet. Launch your arsenal of bombs on the enemy boats and have fun remembering those childhood games for two players. Hit and sunk! Discover the fleet battle game we have designed for classic games lovers! Enjoy destroying your opponents' battleship and win! ABOUT TELLMEWOW Tellmewow is a mobile game development studio specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability which makes our games ideal for the elderly or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.
